title: Project bootstrap state (knowledge/_bootstrap/STATE.yaml)
description: T73 — the one file that tracks whether a project has gone through Discovery (T74-T79) and Human Validation (T80) yet. One file per project (or per module, when `module` is set), because bootstrap runs once, not once per knowledge item. Committed, like the rest of `knowledge/`: whether a project is Ready is a fact the whole team needs, not a local run detail.

module.description: _docs/module/<name> this bootstrap covers, or null for a project that has not split into modules yet.

status.description: Derived from `stages` and `validated_by`/`validated_at` — see bootstrapModel.ts's computeStatus(). A hand-edited file that disagrees with the derivation is rejected by checkBootstrapState(), not silently trusted.

stages.description: Exactly one record per T74-T79 discovery stage plus T79's human-input stage, in a fixed order (see ALL_STAGES).

validated_by.description: T80 — the person who reviewed the discovered knowledge and approved it. A name, not a role: same reasoning as knowledge-conflict.schema.json's decided_by.

knowledge_ids.description: Items this stage produced (T61 ids) — how bootstrap and the knowledge base cross-check each other.
